name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Kobe-Style Beef Sliders on Brioche (Plain Mod)
whyItWorks: Two petite Kobe-style American Wagyu beef sliders grilled tender and served on soft brioche slider buns with melted cheddar. Smaller slider portions prevent stomach distension.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Kobe-Style Sliders plain with ketchup only (hold beer-braised onions and garlic aioli).
watchOuts: Hold beer-braised onions and garlic aioli
